get.description: Returns active documents shared with the authenticated user. Revoked and expired shares are excluded.
Lists pending friend requests received by the authenticated user.

post.description: Creates a pending friendship from the authenticated user to the given user. If a previously ended friendship already exists between the two users in either direction, it is re-activated as pending. If the target user is already a friend or a pending request already exists, a 409 is returned.

user_id.description: ID of the user to send the friend request to. Must be a different user with an active account.

409.description: Conflict - already friends or a pending request already exists

message.example: You are already friends with this user.
You cannot send a friend request to this user.

user_id: You cannot send a friend request to this user.

429.description: Too many requests - throttled to 10 per minute

post.description: Accepts a pending friend request. Only the addressee of the request may accept it.

403.description: Forbidden - only the addressee can accept the request

message.example: You cannot accept this friend request.

409.description: Conflict - the friend request is no longer pending

message.example: This friend request is no longer pending.

post.description: Rejects a pending friend request. Only the addressee of the request may reject it.

403.description: Forbidden - only the addressee can reject the request

message.example: You cannot reject this friend request.

409.description: Conflict - the friend request is no longer pending

message.example: This friend request is no longer pending.

get.description: Lists accepted friendships involving the authenticated user. A friendship accepted in either direction (the authenticated user as requester or addressee) is returned, with the other side reported as the friend. The friend id, name and email may be null if the related user is unavailable.

delete.description: Ends an accepted friendship. Only the requester or the addressee of the friendship may remove it. The friendship is marked as rejected.

403.description: Forbidden - only the requester or addressee can remove the friendship

409.description: Conflict - the friendship is no longer active

message.example: This friendship is no longer active.

get.description: Paginated list of the authenticated user's notifications, newest first, 20 per page.

data.description: The notification payload stored by the notification class (free-form).

example.message: Jane Smith sent you a friend request.

patch.description: Marks one of the authenticated user's notifications as read.

404.description: Notification not found for the authenticated user

patch.description: Marks all of the authenticated user's unread notifications as read.
